title: Each profile's response contract is exactly what its supervisor reads and nothing more
asA: operator whose service is probed by a supervisor with a fixed idea of what a probe response looks like
iWant: the response contract to match the supervisor's shape and stay minimal
soThat: the supervisor's parsing never sees an unexpected field and the surface never carries operational detail the supervisor does not read

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `loadBalancer` profile answers with an empty response body and the resolved status code (200 pass, 503 fail).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the `loadBalancer` profile whose readiness predicate is pass, then fail
acceptanceCriteria.when: an HTTP GET is issued against the resolved health path in each state
acceptanceCriteria.then: the pass response has status 200 with content-length 0 and no body; the fail response has status 503 with content-length 0 and no body

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `kubernetes` profile answers with a JSON body of exactly `{"status":"pass"}` or `{"status":"fail"}` and no additional keys.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the `kubernetes` profile with liveness pass and readiness pass, then readiness fail
acceptanceCriteria.when: an HTTP GET is issued against `/live` and `/ready` in each state and the parsed JSON body key set is inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: the parsed body is exactly a one-key object whose only key is `status` and whose value is `pass` or `fail` matching the resolved answer

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `dockerHealthcheck` profile exits with code 0 on pass and a non-zero code on fail; the profile emits no HTTP surface.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configured with `probeInterface.profile: dockerHealthcheck` and the profile's readiness predicate pass, then fail
acceptanceCriteria.when: the profile's healthcheck command entry point is invoked in each state
acceptanceCriteria.then: the pass invocation exits with code 0; the fail invocation exits with a non-zero code; the process opens no HTTP probe listener when this profile is selected
